chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said to him:
“Recite ‘Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad’ and ‘Qul yā ayyuhā al-kāfirūn’ at the time of your sleep
for it is a disavowal of shirk.”
is the description of the Lord, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.اِقْرَأْ: Recite; an instruction to read these Qur'anic passages
key_terms.بَرَاءَةٌ: Freedom or disavowal, here from shirk
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ, affirming Allah’s absolute oneness
key_terms.قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ: Sūrat al-Kāfirūn, expressing disavowal from false worship
key_terms.مَنَامِكَ: Your sleep; the time before sleeping

ai.seo_question: What should be recited before sleep for disavowal of shirk?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs reciting Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ and Sūrat al-Kāfirūn before sleep. It presents these recitations as a declaration of freedom from shirk and identifies Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ as expressing the Lord’s description.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1353 - Abdullah ibn Sinan reports from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"Recite 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas) and ‘Qul ya-ayyuhal kaafirun’ (Surah al-Kafirun) before you sleep,
for they are a declaration of freedom from shirk (associating partners with Allah (swt)),
affirms the nature of the Lord (azj), Mighty and Majestic."
